assumptions: Entry at the signal session's close; evaluation starts the next session.
When one bar touches both the stop and a target, the stop wins.
A gap below the stop fills at that session's open.
One open trade per asset at a time; no fees or slippage.
Fundamentals are not point-in-time, so the fundamentals rule is skipped.
caveats: Survivorship: the watchlist was chosen today, so history favours assets that did well.
Small samples: a handful of trades says little; read the interval, not the point estimate.
Bars that failed quality checks were excluded, so some sessions are missing.
Past behaviour of these rules is not a promise about future results.

readiness: Exchange hours, closes 16:00 New York time
quality: A value is not finite, `low <= 0`, `volume < 0`, or `low <= min(open, close) <= max(open, close) <= high` fails.
The close moved by a split ratio (2, 3, 4, 5, 10, 1.5, or the inverse) within 1%, and the provider reported no split that day. Never applied to crypto.
The close moved more than `suspect_jump_pct` (20% stocks and ETFs, 35% crypto) and volume was under half its 20-session average.
Within the cross-check window, the primary and cross-check closes differ by more than 2%.
Within the cross-check window, no cross-check close was available.
rules: RSI14 < 25, or close within 1% of the latest confirmed swing low (radius 2)
P/E in (0, 100] and revenue growth >= -20%, when known
reviews: Close below the highest close since entry minus 3 x ATR14
Close below the 200-session average for 3 sessions in a row
Position weight above 20% of the portfolio
No verified price, or the latest verified price is not current
scorecard: Signals that stopped, hit T2, or expired with a verified price
Share of resolved signals whose price reached T1 at any point
Share of resolved signals whose final outcome was above 0R under the named exit model
Mean outcome in R per resolved signal under the named exit model
90% bootstrap interval for expectancy, 2,000 resamples, fixed seed
Median calendar days from signal to exit

reasons.stale_session: the latest closed session is missing

reasons.suspect_bar: a bar moved sharply without volume confirmation
reasons.invalid_bar: a bar failed basic price checks
reasons.corporate_action_pending: a possible split or adjustment is unconfirmed
reasons.single_source_unverified: only one price source covers this asset
reasons.trend_filter_failed: the medium-term trend is not clearly up
reasons.below_floor: price is too far below the 200-session average
reasons.volatility_too_high: daily range is too wide for the stop rule
reasons.no_pullback_trigger: no oversold reading or support test
reasons.no_breakout: price has not closed above its 52-week high
reasons.volume_not_confirmed: volume did not confirm the move
reasons.reward_risk_below_minimum: reward to risk is below the minimum
reasons.fundamentals_excluded: valuation or growth is outside the allowed range
reasons.precision_too_coarse: levels collapse at the exchange price increment
reasons.stop_not_positive: the stop would be at or below zero
reasons.concentration_cap_reached: position size was limited by the concentration cap
reasons.asset_class_cap_reached: the asset-class exposure cap is already reached
reasons.strategy_not_activated: strategy has no backtest report yet, so it is not live
reasons.fundamentals_ok: valuation and growth are within range
reasons.fundamentals_unavailable: no fundamentals on file; rule skipped
reasons.below_chandelier_stop: closed below the trailing review stop
reasons.below_ma200: closed below the 200-session average for several sessions
reasons.above_concentration_cap: position is above the concentration cap
reasons.drawdown_from_peak: drawdown from the post-entry peak is large
